ANSWER (kind: answer; what the learner sees, rebuilt from the answer call)
In Mentor Practice, Title moves by its own keys and rides on CTRL, a null moved by keys. All of them are linear, which means they stop at full speed:
- Title has 4 Position keys, 2 Scale keys and 2 Opacity keys.
- CTRL has 2 Position keys and also carries Subtitle.

STEPS (drawn by the panel from step data, numbered, with each tag)
1. Select Title's last Position keyframe, then choose Animation > Keyframe Assistant > Easy Ease In.  [tag: Easing; layer: Title]
2. Select Title's last Scale keyframe and apply Easy Ease In the same way.  [tag: Easing; layer: Title]
3. Select CTRL's last Position keyframe and apply Easy Ease In. This softens Subtitle's landing too.  [tag: Easing; layer: CTRL]
4. Play it back and watch the landing.  [no tag]
